# Public addresses approved for author and committer metadata.
#
# Every address here is already published in this repository's public history.
# The audit exists to catch a *new* identity arriving — a private address
# configured on a contributor's machine and committed by accident — not to
# re-litigate the addresses that are already on GitHub.
#
# The list was seeded with one address and never reconciled against the object
# database, so `npm run audit:identities` failed for every commit this package
# has ever had, and with it `release:check` and `prepublishOnly`.
#
